with SOTC_NATIVE=1 no VU1 program runs (they only fed the GS); VIF1 still unpacks and keeps TOP/TOPS/DBF; PS2X_VU1_RUN=1 runs them again. CPU per test route 165 s -> 79 s

no IOP code runs, boot included: the IRXs are recorded as loaded; sound by the native SG2 driver, DBCMAN by a host service, vibration and the USB console completed without effect; the boot layout made deterministic (the letter post waits for GAMECORE's image)

with SOTC_NATIVE=1 the DMA chains are still walked (tags only) but no data is copied for nothing: the VIF1 stream keeps only its VIFcodes (UNPACK/MPG/DIRECT data left out), and GIF data (VIF1 DIRECT and the GIF channel) is read in place for its event registers only (SIGNAL/FINISH/LABEL). DMA/VIF1/GIF cost on the route about 6x lower; host system time 13 s -> 7 s
with SOTC_NATIVE=1 the GS rasterizes nothing and its local memory is not written (texture uploads, CLUT loads skipped); registers and signals still run (PS2X_GS_NODRAW=0 turns it all back on)

the IRX is not run: RPC 0x11223344 answered on the host, its 36 commands applied to the SPU2 (volumes, pitch, key on/off, transfers, streamed voices, PCM input, reverb studio C). Loudness on the route follows the emulated driver's; on with SOTC_NATIVE=1 (PS2X_NATIVE_SG2=0 turns it off)

with SOTC_NATIVE=1 a host mixer (SoundMixer) plays the voices, envelopes, PS2 reverb and streamed PCM; the emulated SPU2 stays idle. Same sound as the emulated SPU2 on the route; PS2X_AUDIO_PULL=1 mixes in the host audio thread (for the Vita); with SOTC_NATIVE=1 the mix runs in the host audio thread (PS2X_AUDIO_PULL), off the game thread
